description:
**Project Role :** 
 Custom Software Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 SAP ABAP Development for HANA
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs \\+ tools \\+ retrieval \\+ evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production\\-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflows—without training foundation models from scratch.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)


 Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
   

  

 Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
   

  

 Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
   

  

* Modern ABAP Development \\& Clean Design


 Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
   

  

 Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract\\-first behavior.
   

  

 Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
   

  

* Data Modeling, Reporting \\& Semantic Enablement


 Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
   

  

 Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
   

  

 Ensure lineage\\-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
   

  

* AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic \\+ Grounded)


 Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
   

  

* Tool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
* Retrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
* Deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low


 Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
   

  

* Quality Engineering \\& Evaluation Loops (AI \\+ ABAP)


 Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
   

  

 Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors: offline golden datasets, scenario\\-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
   

  

 Introduce guardrails for AI outputs: authorization\\-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
   

  

* Observability, Reliability \\& Operations


 Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root\\-cause analysis.
   

  

 Design robust error handling for enterprise flows: retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
   

  

 Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
   

  

* Integration \\& End to End Delivery


 Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event\\-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
   

  

 Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
   

  

 Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.
   

  

**Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)**
 Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
   

  

 Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
   

  

 Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
   

  

 Solid software engineering discipline: clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
   

  

 AI native build capability: LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.
   

  

 Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
   

  

 OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract\\-first development.
   

  

 Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query\\-plan driven tuning practices.
   

  

 Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.
   

  

 What This Role Does Not Center On
   

  

 Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
   

  

 AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.
   

  

 Value Delivered
   

  

 High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
   

  

 Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
   

  

 Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI\\-enabled actions.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 A 15 years full time education is required

**About Dataflo** 




 Dataflo builds AI Products for US government agencies. Our products support public records management, legislative tracking, policy analysis, data intelligence, and AI\\-assisted workflows.
 



  





 Public\\-sector software carries real consequences. The people using our products are accountable to citizens, auditors, courts, and elected officials. Outputs must be traceable, sensitive information must remain protected, and the product must work for staff who have little time for training.
 



  





 “The feature mostly works” is not an acceptable standard.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Product Engineer, you will own a meaningful part of the product from beginning to end: understanding the problem, designing the experience, building the solution, deploying it, and verifying that it works in production.
 



  





 You will work across product, design, engineering, data, and AI without treating any of them as someone else’s responsibility. The playbook for deploying AI products into government agencies is still being written, and you will help define it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Take customer problems from discovery through design, development, deployment, and post\\-launch verification.
* Build information\\-dense workflows, dashboards, and AI assistant interfaces that agency staff can understand quickly.
* Ship production code across React, TypeScript, backend services, REST APIs, authentication, SQL, integrations, and data pipelines.
* Build AI features using prompting, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and human\\-review safeguards.
* Make trust visible by showing sources, confidence, decision history, and where human approval is required.
* Build accessibility into the product from the beginning, following WCAG and Section 508 requirements.
* Design secure workflows that protect personal information, enforce access controls, and create complete audit trails.
* Join customer discovery calls, review recordings, observe real usage, and turn what you learn into shipped improvements.
* Decide what should remain specific to one agency and what should become a reusable product capability.
* Diagnose production issues, deploy fixes, verify them directly, and communicate clearly about what happened.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools throughout planning, implementation, testing, and review.
* Build evaluation harnesses for AI\\-powered behavior so improvements and regressions are measured before release.



  





**How We Work** 



* Own the whole loop. The person who finds a problem helps drive it through root cause, resolution, deployment, and verification.
* Move with urgency and judgment. We value fast execution, but speed does not replace security, testing, or careful review.
* Done means proven. A feature is not complete because the code was pushed. It must be deployed, tested in the real environment, and observed long enough to trust.
* Security and compliance are part of the product. The safe outcome should be the default. Sensitive actions require appropriate controls, uncertain outcomes stop for human review, and important activity must be auditable.
* AI\\-assisted, engineer\\-owned. AI tools can draft, explore, test, and accelerate the work. You remain responsible for understanding, reviewing, measuring, and owning everything that ships.
* Truth over ego. If something failed, say so. If an assumption was wrong, change direction when the evidence arrives.
* Meetings should create movement. Come prepared with evidence, options, and a recommendation. Leave with clear ownership and begin the work.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Experience shipping production software and taking real ownership of the outcome.
* Strong React and TypeScript skills, with attention to interaction details, loading behavior, errors, permissions, and edge cases.
* Comfort working with APIs, authentication, SQL, backend services, and messy real\\-world data.
* Practical experience building with LLMs, including prompting, retrieval, evaluation, and human\\-review workflows.
* Strong product and information\\-design instincts. You care whether the interface is understandable, not only whether it functions.
* The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into something useful that can ship quickly.
* A habit of reproducing issues, investigating evidence, and verifying fixes yourself.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to occasionally overlap with US working hours for customer discussions, launches, or urgent production issues.
* A portfolio or project history showing what you personally designed, built, and shipped.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Exposure to government technology, civic technology, healthcare, finance, or another regulated environment.
* Experience with document\\-heavy AI products and retrieval over long, inconsistent source material.
* Experience designing data visualizations for non\\-technical users.
* Familiarity with audit logging, role\\-based access, data privacy, and compliance\\-oriented product development.
* Experience building accessible products to WCAG or Section 508 standards.



  





**How to Apply** 



* Your latest resume and LinkedIn profile.
* **Add this as a section in your resume:** 
 Submit your AI projects or prototypes you have personally built. It can be an AI product, prototype, internal tool, automation, workflow, or production feature that solved a real problem.



  





 We care more about how clearly you understand the problem, the choices you made, and the outcome you achieved than about how polished the presentation is.
